label: Chisinau
sub: Capital; site of PM Munteanu's July 3 resignation and Tofan's July 21 confirmation

label: Tiraspol
sub: De facto Transnistrian capital; hub for Russian citizenship processing under the May 15 decree

label: Cobasna Ammunition Depot
sub: OGRF-guarded Soviet-era stockpile of ~19,000-22,000 tonnes of munitions, 2km from the Ukrainian border

label: Cuciurgan Power Plant (MGRES)
sub: Formerly gas-fired plant supplying up to 80% of Moldova's electricity; switched to coal in Feb 2026

label: Bender / Security Zone
sub: Joint peacekeeping security zone on the Nistru's west bank, controlled by Transnistrian and Moldovan/Russian forces

label: Crocmaz, Ștefan Vodă District
sub: Aerial object crashed and exploded near a tree line on Aug 9, first UAV wreckage find since 2022

label: Priozerne, Slobozia District
sub: Drone crossed into Moldovan airspace from Ukraine on Aug 10, returned without incident

label: Talmaza
sub: Third airspace breach in nine days; object exploded in a cornfield, sparking forest fires

label: Galați, Romania
sub: Spanish F/A-18 shot down a Shahed-type drone ~24km north of Galați after it crossed via Moldova

label: Cahul / Romanian Border
sub: Key crossing point for Romanian electricity and gas imports diversifying Moldova away from Russian supply

label: Former Russian Cultural Centre, Chisinau
sub: Permanently shut July 4 after parliament terminated the underlying bilateral treaty

label: Parliament of Moldova
sub: Elected PM Vasile Tofan 53-21 on July 21; declared OGRF commanders persona non grata Apr 17

label: Slobozia District
sub: Southeastern Transnistria-adjacent district repeatedly overflown during Russian strikes on Odesa

label: Ștefan Vodă District
sub: Border district that recorded two of the three August drone incidents (Crocmaz, Talmaza)

label: EU Accession Track
sub: First ("Fundamentals") cluster opened Jun 15; second (external relations) cluster opened Jul 14

label: Maiac, Grigoriopol District
sub: Site of the 2022 unclaimed radio-tower explosions that knocked out Russian rebroadcast transmitters

label: Tiraspoltransgaz Hub
sub: Gas transit and metering infrastructure supplying Cuciurgan under the Moldovagaz-MET Group arrangement

label: Comrat, Gagauzia
sub: Capital of Moldova's pro-Russian autonomous Gagauz region, a persistent source of anti-EU electoral opposition

label: Odesa Oblast Border Zone
sub: Ukrainian territory adjoining Moldova/Transnistria where Russian strikes repeatedly spill drones across the border

label: Government House, Chisinau
sub: Seat of the executive; MoldATSA scandal and Munteanu's resignation triggered a full cabinet collapse here

label: Etulia, Gagauzia
sub: Fourth airspace breach since Aug 9; Shahed-type drone crossed into southern Moldova and back in six minutes on Aug 19-20

label: Tabachi-Mirne Border Crossing
sub: Ukraine-side checkpoint buildings damaged by Russian drones ~300m from Moldovan territory on Aug 21, crossing suspended

label: Caplani, Ștefan Vodă District
sub: Fifth airspace breach since Aug 9; Shahed-138 crossed into Moldova and back within 17 minutes on Aug 22

label: Vulcănești, Gagauzia
sub: Sixth airspace breach since Aug 9; drone overflew the town en route from Ukraine to Romania on Aug 24, prompting a 15-minute airspace restriction and a Romanian F-16 scramble

label: Vynohradivka Border Checkpoint
sub: Ukraine-side crossing struck by a Russian Shahed-type drone on Aug 25, the third border-crossing strike in two weeks; traffic suspended ~24 hours

label: Palanca, Ștefan Vodă District
sub: Seventh airspace breach since Aug 9; drone entered near Palanca at 17:38 and exited toward Tudora at 17:43 on Aug 26

label: Chisinau-Basarabeasca Highway (approximate)
sub: Drone wreckage found on Moldovan soil Aug 27 — only the second confirmed debris find since Crocmaz on Aug 9; forensic and bomb-disposal teams deployed
